about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Andrea Salinas

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AFFORDABILITY
statements.title: AFFORDABILITY
sentences: Since President Trump took office, Oregonians have had to pay an extra $3,900 because of inflation, his tariffs, and his war with Iran.

I could stand here all day listing what has gotten more expensive because of his harmful policies, but I only have 60 seconds, so I want to highlight how just one of his failures, the war in Iran, is hurting Americans.
Before the war, farmers in my district paid $4.22 a gallon for diesel.
Now Trump's war is driving up fuel costs, and my farmers are now paying $5.87 for that same gallon of diesel.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1501, PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 9436, NORTHEAST LOBSTERMAN PROTECTION ACT OF 2
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1501, PROTECTING DOMESTIC MINING ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 9436, NORTHEAST LOBSTERMAN PROTECTION ACT OF 2026; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION...
sentences: He has pushed for the SAVE America Act, helped undermine the Voting Rights Act, and most recently has urged the courts to restrict mail-in voting, even though the President himself votes by mail.
He can't stand the thought of losing again, and that is why he is trying to prevent Americans from voting by mail.
We have been an entirely vote-by-mail State for nearly 30 years, and our elections have been safe and secure.
Oregon consistently has some of the highest levels of voter turnout in the country, and research has shown that voters from both sides of the aisle vote by mail at similar rates.
That is why I introduced the Universal Right To Vote by Mail Act.
My bill would give every eligible voter in America the right to vote by mail in Federal elections without requiring a specific excuse.
He is attacking vote-by-mail because he is afraid of the results when voters make their voices heard this November.
Congress must reject the attacks on vote-by-mail.
I urge my colleagues to defeat the previous question and support my Universal Right To Vote by Mail Act so every eligible American can cast their ballot safely, securely, and conveniently.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MOON LANDING DAY
statements.title: MOON LANDING DAY
sentences: Through NASA's Artemis program, the U.S. will once again set foot on the Moon, opening the door for the next era of space exploration.
But missions like Artemis would not be possible without the skilled technical workers, scientists, and innovators whose talent turns bold ideas into reality.
That is why I urge my colleagues to pass my resolution that would recognize July 20, the day the astronauts landed on the Moon, as Moon Day.
Mr. Speaker, I will keep working to support policies that get us one small step closer to the next giant leap for mankind. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NUCLEIC ACID STANDARDS FOR BIOSECURITY ACT
statements.title: NUCLEIC ACID STANDARDS FOR BIOSECURITY ACT
sentences: As this field advances, particularly with the development of AI systems to design nucleic acid sequences, we need to double down on efforts to ensure the technology is used safely and responsibly.
Through a commonsense partnership between government and industry, we will unlock responsible and trustworthy growth that benefits industry, workers, and consumers across the economy.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NEXT-GENERATION GEOTHERMAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT ACT
statements.title: NEXT-GENERATION GEOTHERMAL RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT ACT
sentences: In addition to rising demand, aging infrastructure, rising fuel costs, and climate-change-driven disasters like winter ice storms, wildfires, and drought are also driving up the cost of electricity.

Geothermal energy already delivers clean, round-the-clock power in the Western U.S. Building on these innovations, next-gen geothermal technologies can play an important part in the transition to an affordable and reliable clean energy future across the country.
Next-gen geothermal technologies will make it feasible to deploy geothermal energy across the country and serve as a critical tool in the fight against climate change.
Madam Speaker, I thank my colleague Mr. Harrigan for his leadership on this sensible, bipartisan bill, and I urge everyone to vote ``yes'' on H.R. 8790.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RESTORE DEVASTATING CUTS TO SNAP
statements.title: RESTORE DEVASTATING CUTS TO SNAP
sentences: It was to give tax cuts to his billionaire buddies.
No child, veteran, or senior in the wealthiest nation on the planet should go hungry because Republicans chose tax breaks for billionaires over food for families. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: INVEST IN A DIVERSE PORTFOLIO OF AFFORDABLE, CLEAN ENERGY
statements.title: INVEST IN A DIVERSE PORTFOLIO OF AFFORDABLE, CLEAN ENERGY
sentences: Diesel is even higher, around $6 a gallon.

For the sake of our wallets, our environment, and the future workforce and economy, we need to invest in a diverse portfolio of affordable, clean energy and rein in Trump's recklessness. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RELATING TO A NATIONAL EMERGENCY BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 1, 2025
statements.title: RELATING TO A NATIONAL EMERGENCY BY THE PRESIDENT ON FEBRUARY 1, 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to oppose President Trump's disastrous tariffs and shine a light on the real harm they are causing families and businesses in my district.
After Trump imposed his tariffs, Canada responded with their own tariffs that lasted for months.
Wineries in my district built their relationships across the border over decades, and in one day, President Trump destroyed them.
These tariffs hurt American farmers and American consumers alike.
Mr. Speaker, I urge an ``aye'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: I will share just a few messages from my hardworking constituents who will be impacted.
She wrote: ``We will probably choose to only insure our child.

We cannot afford 25 percent of our income going to health insurance.'' Janice from Salem said that her monthly costs will go from $465 to $1,100. ``I will go without health insurance if I can't bring it way down to no more than $500 a month.
Mr. Speaker, I urge an ``aye'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT CHILDREN'S INNOCENCE ACT
statements.title: PROTECT CHILDREN'S INNOCENCE ACT
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in opposition to this disgusting bill that does nothing to protect children's innocence.
It permits Federal law enforcement to act as the national gender police, allowing them to invade children's private medical records.

This bill puts even more children in harm's way and exacerbates the mental health crises that our young people are facing because it stops them from actually receiving the care that they need right now.

To my Republican colleagues, why not focus on the issues that will impact millions of families who are just one paycheck away from homelessness or losing their healthcare instead of waging a war on children's genitals?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE RURAL SCHOOLS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SECURE RURAL SCHOOLS REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of S. 356, the Secure Rural Schools Reauthorization Act, my bipartisan legislation with Representatives LaMalfa and Neguse in the House and Senators Crapo and Wyden in the Senate.
Mr. Speaker, I am proud to support this bill, and I urge my colleagues to support it, as well.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
statements.title: FIGHTING DHS IMMIGRATION RAIDS
sentences: When I asked about the detainees not being able to access medication, facility officials told me that detainees often lie about the lack of access to medical care.
When I asked about detainees not being able to access their attorneys, facility officials told me, oh, there are tablets that they can access and there are lots of rooms.
I will continue to conduct oversight and publicize the horrific acts of ICE.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RURAL MENTAL HEALTHCARE
statements.title: RURAL MENTAL HEALTHCARE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today to highlight the growing mental health care crisis in rural America.

That is why I have introduced legislation to support clinicians who commit to practicing in rural areas and to expand telemental health services tailored to farmers, fishers, and foresters, the people who power our rural economies.
I urge my colleagues to join me in ensuring rural Americans are no longer overlooked or underserved. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RAISING A QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE
statements.title: RAISING A QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my friend and colleague, Congressman Garcia.
I urge my colleagues to reject this reprimand.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MENTAL HEALTH OF FARMERS
statements.title: MENTAL HEALTH OF FARMERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, September is National Suicide Prevention Month.
Despite this crisis, my Republican colleagues recently passed their big, ugly bill, which guts Medicaid.
Medicaid provides access to the care many in our rural communities need.
Because of these cruel cuts, Oregonians will lose out on lifesaving mental and behavioral health care, and the mental health crisis will only get worse.

I have a bill, the Home-Based Telemental Health Care Act, that would expand access to remote mental health and substance use services in rural America, specifically for individuals working in the farming, fishing, and forestry industries.

Mr. Speaker, it is time we come together to pass legislation that will address our Nation's growing mental health crisis and provide farmers and people in rural communities the care they deserve. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: In the dark of morning, they are trying to ram through legislation that will raise costs, strip away healthcare, take food off the tables of working families, and increase energy costs for all Americans, all to give tax breaks to billionaires and corporations.
Cuts to Medicaid will shutter rural hospitals, nursing homes, and health centers, leaving families with higher costs and nowhere to turn for care.
I urge my colleagues to have the moral courage to oppose this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING THE LGBTQ+ COMMUNITY
statements.title: SUPPORTING THE LGBTQ+ COMMUNITY
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of the LGBTQ community to celebrate Pride Month, and to call out President Trump's reckless decision to shut down the 988 specialized LGBTQ youth hotline.
I will put this into perspective: In 2024, 12 percent of LGBTQ youth attempted suicide, while nearly 40 percent seriously considered it.
Mental health is not a partisan issue, and our children should not be used as pawns in the President's purely political game.

As the co-chair of the bipartisan Mental Health Caucus, I am committed to expanding access to specialty mental health care by training qualified professionals to provide culturally relevant care and ensuring that high-quality, affordable services are available to all who need them.
Mr. Speaker, I will not remain silent in the face of President Trump's targeted attacks, and I will continue to fight for the LGBTQ communities. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ILLEGAL FIRINGS COULD DEVASTATE OREGON
statements.title: ILLEGAL FIRINGS COULD DEVASTATE OREGON
sentences: Madam Speaker, I won't be silent as the administration continues to wreak havoc on our country, on our forest, and on our people.
With or without my Republican colleagues, I will continue to fight for our vulnerable communities. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IT IS TIME TO GET OFF THE BENCH
statements.title: IT IS TIME TO GET OFF THE BENCH
sentences: I am committed to building bipartisan consensus on this issue, so no matter who you root for this weekend, I hope you will join me to support the GRIT Act. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MAKING OUR COMMUNITIES SAFER AND MORE AFFORDABLE
statements.title: MAKING OUR COMMUNITIES SAFER AND MORE AFFORDABLE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to President Trump's unlawful attempt to end birthright citizenship.
Oregon sent me here to fight for them, and that is exactly what I intend to do. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: In fact, the bill subjects girls, cisgender and transgender girls, to harm and ridicule, and it strips fairness from players, parents, and school communities.
The bill sets up an unfair playing field where any parent can raise a concern that a transgender girl might be playing on a girls' team, and we know this is so very rare.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to H.R. 28.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to leave these decisions in the hands of parents and local sports authorities and vote ``no'' on H.R. 28.
